description: Oil pressure control solenoid for VTEC system engagement

dohc_vtec_b_series.notes: Replace gasket and filter screen during replacement

sohc_vtec_d_series.location: Back of cylinder head near distributor

i_vtec_k_series.notes: K-series uses VTC actuator in addition to VTEC solenoid

vtc_actuator.notes: Cold start rattle often caused by VTC actuator. Common wear item

gasket_leak.symptom: Oil leak from VTEC solenoid area

clogged_screen.symptom: VTEC not engaging or delayed engagement
clogged_screen.prevention: Regular oil changes with quality oil

solenoid_failure.symptom: No VTEC engagement, CEL with VTEC codes
solenoid_failure.diagnosis: Check resistance (14-30 ohms typical), check oil pressure

maintenance_notes.inspection_interval: Every 80,000 km or with timing belt service
maintenance_notes.oil_quality: Critical for VTEC operation - use Honda or equivalent spec oil

vtec_controllers.description: Devices to adjust VTEC engagement point
